#+title: sift — the rule catalogue
#+author: generated by sift from the checker records
#+options: toc:2 num:nil
#+language: en

/Do not edit this file by hand./  It is written by ~maak docs~ from the
same records that ~sift list-checkers~ prints and that the linter runs,
and the test suite fails when it falls behind.  What each rule is
*for* -- the reasoning, and the style the rules belong to -- is in
[[file:style.org][style.org]].

There are 63 rules in sift 1.13.0.

** SIFT046 beta-reduction
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: beta-reduction
:END:

A lambda applied in place, where a ~let~ would say the same thing once

- *Dialects:* scheme, elisp, cl
- *Severity:* info
- *Fix:* (let ((x (g))) (f x))

((lambda (x) (f x)) (g))
#+end_src

#+begin_quote

#+end_quote


** SIFT052 blank-line-in-body
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: blank-line-in-body

- *Severity:* info

** SIFT051 comment-semicolons
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: comment-semicolons
:END:

A comment's semicolon level does not say where it belongs

- *Dialects:* all
- *Severity:* info
- *Fix:* use three at top level, two inside a form, one at the end of a line

#+begin_src scheme
(define (f x)
  ;; two semicolons, in a body
  x)
;; one semicolon, at top level

#+end_src

#+begin_quote
Run ~sift explain comment-semicolons~ at the command line, or ~M-x sift-explain-at-point~ in Emacs with the cursor on a finding.
#+end_quote

:CUSTOM_ID: line-length
:END:

Line exceeds the configured soft limit (96 columns, 80 in Emacs Lisp)

- *Dialects:* all
- *Severity:* warning
- *Fix:* no automatic fix; break the form by hand

#+begin_src scheme
(define (f x) (some-very-long-call ...))  ; over 96 columns
#+end_src

#+begin_quote
Run ~sift explain line-length~ at the command line, or ~M-x sift-explain-at-point~ in Emacs with the cursor on a finding.
#+end_quote

** SIFT040 naming-convention

** SIFT033 negated-if

** SIFT044 nesting-depth
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: nesting-depth
:END:

A definition whose body nests deeper than the configured limit

- *Dialects:* all
- *Severity:* warning
- *Fix:* no automatic fix; extract the inner form into its own procedure

#+begin_src scheme
(define (f x)
  (if (a) (if (b) (if (c)
    (if (d) (if (e) 1 2))))))
#+end_src

#+begin_quote
Run ~sift explain nesting-depth~ at the command line, or ~M-x sift-explain-at-point~ in Emacs with the cursor on a finding.
#+end_quote
